decisions.reason: The firm has given the IMU module more visibility by moving it to a page of its own, so the commitment is growing and the product fits its core modular sensor platform.
The industrial AC input module has had its own page in both years and was publicly announced as a new launch, which makes it a visible, justified part of the firm's industrial expansion.

The relay module has only been mentioned, never featured, but it costs little to keep in a modular catalogue, belongs to the core product line, and its modest visibility can still be put down to a slow ramp-up.
The LED control module launched only recently, so weak results can still be blamed on temporary causes, and it fits the firm's established building-block ecosystem.

The wallbox remote access service is further from the core hardware business and has had little exposure, but it was launched recently and signals a new service direction, so management will likely persist rather than admit failure this early.
